_help: Every rogue boss. The first block of fields is the One Piece Mod's own character format (see its characters.json): health, damage, Berries dropped (bounty), size, the two special attacks (power, hardPower: any of the main mod's BossAbility powers) and the Hard/Expert prizes. The rest is this mod's: hitbox ([width, height] in blocks before the size is applied, to fit its model), bountyReward (how much a first win raises your bounty), crew (an NPC kit from crews.json, or "" to fight alone), signature (the phase 3 move, see RogueSignatures.java), the lines it shouts, where its rumor drops (rumorFrom: main mod NPC kit ids) and its trophy.

bosses.name: "Saltjaw" Gully Rourke
bosses.lore: A salvage pirate who drags his ship's anchor behind him on a chain. Wrecks anything he can sell for scrap.
bosses.intro: That ship of yours'd fetch a fine price as scrap!
bosses.phase2: Lads! Strip 'em down to the nails!
bosses.phase3: Down to the seabed with ya! Anchor's away!

bosses.name: Corvina, the Fog Widow
bosses.lore: Queen of a smuggling ring that only sails in fog. Ships that follow her lanterns are never seen again.
bosses.intro: Follow the lanterns, darling. Everyone does.
bosses.phase2: Lanterns up! Let them drown in the grey.
bosses.phase3: You can't strike what you can't see!

bosses.name: Commodore Hollis "Iron Tide" Graves
bosses.lore: A Navy commodore who deserted with his whole garrison and a hold full of seastone shot. Now he sells "protection" to islands the Navy forgot.
bosses.intro: Justice is a business now. And business is good.
bosses.phase3: Seastone volley! Let's see that fruit save you now!

bosses.name: Tsurugi, the Hollow Ronin
bosses.lore: An empty suit of samurai armor that still fights. Whoever wore it swore to duel until they lost, and never lost.
bosses.phase3: Hollow Cut. There is nothing left inside to stop it.

bosses.name: Boilerheart Gantz
bosses.lore: A shipbreaker who rebuilt himself around a ship's boiler. He eats coal, breathes steam and tears warships apart by hand.
bosses.phase3: PRESSURE'S PAST THE RED! EVERYBODY DOWN!

bosses.name: Nereus Vane, Herald of the Deep
bosses.lore: A fishman prophet who says the sea itself speaks through him. His followers sink ships as offerings to something far below.
bosses.intro: The deep has been waiting for you.
bosses.phase3: Tidal Judgment! Let the sea take back what's hers!
